raw_response:
1. No—there isn’t a benchmark line at 0.8 in the AVG category; the only reference-like values shown are the SOLAR bars labeled 1.00, so the figure does not indicate a 0.8 target threshold.

2. The figure does not show SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 at 0.85 for KoBEST-CP; it shows SOLAR at 1.00 and RedWhale (our) at 0.71 in KoBEST-CP.

3. The figure provides only point values and no variance/error bars, sample sizes, or test details, so statistical significance and p-values cannot be determined from it.
